published_title: You Can Either    On Second Thought Just Be Destroyed
player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''Xavier Six''') posted a [[Light]] [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|Profit]] list on DeckTech in April 2001.

starting.card: You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed

description: This is a fighting/direct damage profit deck. There are two versions I play(one with destiny adders the other with OTE,FPs, and AMO. I like destinies so this is the earlier of the two.
cards: You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed
posted: Han w/b or Gen Han
notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting (8)': You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed ('YCEPBT/OBD'), Tatooine: Jabba's Palace ('TatJP'), Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber ('JP AC'), Heading For The Medical Frigate ('HFTMF'), then under '(varies)': Staging Areas, Insurrection, 'Chasm or Strike Planning', 'Han w/b or Gen Han'; these count toward the 60 (total 60). The '(varies)' line is a sub-heading, not a card. Several Effects start, none is named as the starting Effect, so starting.effect is left empty.

'Chasm or Strike Planning' and 'Han w/b or Gen Han' are one-of-two choices and are printed as written (Strike Planning is also listed separately under Effects; Gen Han is presumably General Solo, already in Characters).
Posted 'DB 97' matches no card (Tatooine: Docking Bay 94 is the likely intent) and the next location line is just 'DB' (a character seems lost before it); both are printed as written.
Posted 'TatJP' dested the Light Tatooine: Jabba's Palace (Special Edition); 'Tatooine' dested the Premiere Light Tatooine system.

Posted 'Chew the Pro' dested Chewbacca, Protector; 'Chew of K' Chewbacca Of Kashyyyk; 'Daughter of S' Daughter Of Skywalker; 'Master L' Master Luke; 'Jedi L' Luke Skywalker, Jedi Knight (listed among Characters); 'Gen Cal' General Calrissian; 'DASH' Dash Rendar (paired with Outrider in the strategy).
Posted 'Obi wan' dested Obi-Wan Kenobi (the card of that name); the deck also runs Ben Kenobi and Obi's Saber.

Posted 'Artoo' and 'Threepio' dested Artoo (Jabba's Palace) and Threepio (Endor); 'Gold S1' Gold Squadron 1; 'A's Saber' Anakin's Lightsaber; 'Chewie's Bow' Chewbacca's Bowcaster; 'Leg Starfighter' Legendary Starfighter; 'Weapon Lev' the Light Weapon Levitation (Jabba's Palace).
